summary: Monday night's Commanders-49ers game is shaped by injuries: Washington's lead back Croskey-Merritt is out, and San Francisco is without Deebo Samuel with Mike Evans and Christian Kirk questionable, which pushes targets to Kittle. The NBA season opens this week with several new roles, including the Spurs' three-guard lineup and Franz Wagner's shoulder in Orlando.

NBA|4432573|ra.note: Wagner, Orlando's No. 2 creator, was limited in Sunday practice with right shoulder soreness and is being evaluated, which would move more playmaking to Banchero; Atlanta's small lineup has had rebounding trouble.

detail.availability: Banchero is healthy. He played 27 minutes in the preseason finale and scored 24.
detail.role: Wagner had 6 assists in 19 minutes before leaving the finale and is listed questionable after light work Sunday. The Sentinel's coverage says his absence would shift more of the creation load to Banchero, and Black (ankle) and Richardson (back) are also limited, which thins the ball-handling.
detail.matchup: Atlanta's preview describes the Hawks as an undersized, turnover-forcing team that has had early rebounding problems. Their rookie big Veesaar is out for the season with a torn ACL.
detail.script: Orlando is favored by 2.5 with a 234.5 total, the highest in this batch, which points to a fast game and more chances for rebounds and assists.
detail.market: No Kalshi price was available, and no prop line moves were found.

NBA|4066320|reb.note: Bane is healthy and started the preseason finale, playing 26 minutes. Atlanta's small lineup helps a little, but no news clearly changes his rebounding.

detail.role: He started the finale and scored 23 points in 26 minutes, mostly on threes. The coverage gave no rebound-specific news.
detail.matchup: Atlanta's preview cites the Hawks' size and early rebounding issues.
detail.script: A 234.5 total means plenty of possessions and missed shots.

NBA|2490149|reb.note: McCollum is locked in as the starting point guard and had 5 rebounds in each of his two 19-minute preseason outings. Orlando's big frontcourt limits guard rebounds, though, so the over has no clear edge.

detail.availability: He missed the preseason opener with a bruised nose and was rested on Oct. 12, then played the Dallas finale. There is no injury concern.
detail.role: Reports say he is locked into a starting role for the Oct. 21 opener. He had 5 rebounds in 19 minutes in each of two early preseason games, then 7 points and 4 assists on 2-of-11 shooting in the finale.
detail.matchup: Banchero, Carter, Vucevic and Wagner give Orlando a lot of size, though Wagner's shoulder may keep him out.
detail.script: A close spread (ORL -2.5) should mean full starter minutes.

NBA|4566434|pts.note: Wagner is questionable after leaving the preseason finale with right shoulder soreness and doing only light work Sunday. If he plays, his minutes and shooting could be limited.

detail.availability: He left the Oct. 16 finale and did not return, was limited to light work Sunday, and the team is still evaluating him with no timeline. He is listed questionable for Wednesday.
detail.role: Black, Cain and da Silva are the named candidates for more minutes if he sits.

NBA|4432573|pts.note: Banchero scored 24 in 27 minutes in the finale, and his scoring load grows if Wagner sits. The 22.5 line already sits near his form, so the edge depends on Wagner's status.

detail.role: He had 16 first-half points and went 13-of-16 from the line in the finale. With Wagner questionable, more of the scoring falls to him.

NBA|4065648|pts.note: Tatum is healthy and now Boston's top option, but his preseason scoring sat around 19-23 points and Detroit's top-two defense makes 26.5 a stretch in the opener.

detail.availability: Expected to play in the opener after resting in Boston's final preseason game; no minutes restriction has been reported.
detail.role: With Jaylen Brown traded to Philadelphia he is the undisputed first option, but in preseason he scored 23 and 19 points, the latter in 29 minutes with no free throws; after his return from the Achilles injury last season he averaged about 22 points in 33 minutes.
detail.matchup: Detroit ranked second in defensive rating last season and held opponents to the league's lowest three-point percentage, with Ausar Thompson as its primary wing stopper.
detail.script: Near pick'em spread and a total around 222 point to a tight, half-court-heavy game, which keeps his minutes up but does not inflate the pace.
detail.market: Consensus line is 26.5, matching the packet; Kalshi at about 45% for the over also leans under. One preview set its line much lower (20.5), a sign that some books are pricing him near his preseason output.
detail.experts: One preview liked him to clear a much lower number (20.5) because he topped 20 in limited preseason games; previews broadly frame him as an MVP candidate in a bigger role, which is the main risk to the under.

NBA|4433621|reb.note: Boston added Mitchell Robinson and used double-big lineups with Queta in preseason to control the glass, which could cap Duren's rebounding; preseason evidence only, so no call.

detail.matchup: Mazzulla paired Robinson and Queta for stretches in preseason, and Boston led the preseason in rebounding percentage while allowing few second-chance points.
detail.market: Kalshi has the over near 46%, a slight lean to the under.

NBA|3078576|pts.note: Brown's departure should push more shots to White, but one preview prices him at 14.5 rather than the packet's 16.5, so no edge at this number.

detail.role: Previews expect White to take a larger scoring share with Brown gone; he averaged about 16 points in two preseason games.
detail.market: One preview lists his points line at 14.5, two points below the packet's 16.5; Kalshi has the over near 47%.

NBA|4395625|pr.note: Barrett's high recent numbers came with Quickley and Ingram out, and Kawhi now joins the starting group; add a near 10-point spread and his usage outlook is uncertain.

detail.availability: No injury listed.
detail.role: Kawhi Leonard (acquired for Ingram) took 12 shots in 17 minutes of his preseason debut while Barrett scored 17 that night and 15 in the preseason opener; Quickley, who missed late last season, is back at point guard.
detail.matchup: Chicago ranked 23rd in defensive rating last season and is without Claxton, which keeps the matchup friendly.
detail.script: Toronto -9.5 with the total rising to 236.5: a fast pace helps volume, but a blowout could trim starters' fourth-quarter minutes.

NBA|4433134|pa.note: A fast, high-total game against a weak Bulls defense without Claxton favors Barnes, but Kawhi's arrival and blowout risk offset it; no clear edge.

detail.role: He had 19 points and 4 assists in the Kawhi debut; previews still describe him as a primary facilitator.
detail.matchup: Chicago allowed a lot of assists and ranked 23rd defensively last season, and without Claxton it has little rim protection.
detail.script: Total up a point to 236.5 with the Bulls planning to run; Toronto -9.5 brings some risk of reduced late minutes.
detail.experts: One preview's best prop is his assists over, citing Chicago's assist rate allowed, though it calls the pick a modest one.

NBA|2595516|reb.note: Powell rested most of preseason and Chicago starts a small Awaka/Smith frontcourt without Claxton, a slight boost to guard rebounding chances but nothing concrete.

detail.role: Powell starts on the wing; with Claxton out, Awaka or Jalen Smith has started at center, and coach Splitter wants more crashing of the glass.

NBA|4871145|ra.note: Without Claxton, Chicago's frontcourt is thinner and Splitter wants to run, which suits Giddey's rebound-and-push game; the 9.5-point spread limits confidence.

detail.role: Giddey led Chicago in assists and rebounds last season and drives its transition game; Claxton's absence leaves more defensive rebounds for the guards.

NBA|4431671|pr.note: McDaniels averaged 14.8 points last season and is now described as Minnesota's third option next to Ball; his health and starting spot look settled but the bigger preseason role could not be confirmed.

detail.availability: No injury listed.
detail.role: Starting forward; preseason 14.8 PPG in 20.7 MPG, with the Randle and Reid departures freeing shots.
detail.matchup: Miami's Giannis/Adebayo frontcourt is long and switchable, a tougher test than preseason opponents.
detail.experts: SI's Wolves site projects him as a possible second-leading scorer if Ball keeps creating for him.

NBA|2528210|pr.note: Hardaway is a bench wing in a crowded Miami rotation (Portis, Jovic, Larsson, Conwell, Fontecchio), and his minutes in the opener are unclear.

detail.availability: Healthy; Larsson's return from illness adds another wing competitor.
detail.role: Scored 14 off the bench against Brooklyn, but Spoelstra used Jovic and Portis first off the bench and rookie Conwell pushed for guard minutes.

NBA|4397002|ra.note: Dosunmu should be in the main bench rotation with DiVincenzo out, but Ball's arrival and Hyland's second-unit role cut into his ball-handling.

detail.availability: No injury.
detail.role: Preseason 9.0 PPG and played well alongside Ball; SI expects the early rotation to lean on him.

NBA|4066261|ast.note: Adebayo practiced Sunday and expects to play, and Spoelstra has described Adebayo and Giannis as initiators while guard Dru Smith recovers from a calf strain.

detail.availability: Missed the last two exhibitions with groin tightness but returned to practice Sunday; no minutes limit reported.
detail.role: Spoelstra plans to start him beside Giannis and have both bigs initiate offense.

NBA|4431671|pts.note: Third-option role next to Ball and last season's 14.8 points support the over, but the reported preseason scoring jump could not be confirmed, so no strong lean.

detail.role: 22 points on 12 shots against the Knicks in preseason; 14.8 PPG overall in about 21 minutes.

NBA|4845367|ast.note: Coach Johnson confirmed Harper joins Fox and Castle in a three-guard starting lineup, splitting playmaking three ways; Castle had 3-5 assists per preseason game and the market leans under.

detail.availability: No injury; he rested one preseason game and his team option was exercised.
detail.role: Johnson said the Fox-Castle-Harper-Vassell-Wembanyama group will start the opener, so Castle shares ball-handling with two other guards; in preseason he logged 3, 5 and 3 assists in 18-24 minutes.
detail.matchup: OKC remains a high-pressure, switching defense even after losing Dort, and Holmgren's possible absence matters more for the paint than for passing lanes.
detail.script: Spurs about 2.5-point favorites with a total near 229.5, so a normal workload but no blowout bonus.
detail.market: Kalshi has the over around 42%, meaning the market leans to the under, consistent with the shared-handler setup.
detail.experts: One preview takes the over, arguing he is still the starting unit's table-setter and his preseason dip came from short minutes; Johnson's lineup choice argues the opposite.

NBA|4395630|pr.note: Vassell keeps his starting job with Harris out, but the three-guard lineup adds another scorer and he shot poorly from three in preseason; nothing concrete moves this line.

detail.availability: Healthy and confirmed in the starting five.
detail.role: Tobias Harris (calf) is out, so Vassell is the lone starting forward next to Wembanyama, but Harper's promotion adds another shot-taker.
detail.experts: Previews mention him only as a starter, with no prop take.

NBA|4278073|ast.note: SGA is healthy, but OKC lost three rotation shooters and Holmgren is uncertain, so it is unclear whether he gets more assists or simply takes more shots; no call.

detail.availability: No injury; OKC rested its top creators for parts of preseason.
detail.role: With Dort, Wiggins and Joe traded and Holmgren (quad) uncertain, previews expect his usage to climb, which could mean more shots rather than more assists.
detail.market: Kalshi is near 49% for the over, so the market is roughly neutral.
detail.experts: One preview backs his points over on the usage argument rather than his assists.

NBA|4066259|ra.note: Three guards now share ball-handling and Kalshi prices Fox's assist over near 37%, which cuts against this over; not concrete enough to call.

detail.role: Fox starts with Castle and Harper; in his preseason debut he had 4 assists.
detail.market: Kalshi has his 5.5-assist over near 37%, a clear market lean against his assist volume.

NBA|4433255|pra.note: Holmgren missed all of preseason with a quad contusion and Daigneault would not commit to him for the opener; even if he plays, rust or a limit is possible.

detail.availability: Day-to-day with a quad injury, no preseason games, and the coach deferred to the injury report.

NBA|4066259|pts.note: One preview lists Fox's points line at 19.5, far above the packet's 14.5; check the current number before using this prop.

detail.market: The packet's 14.5 differs from the 19.5 in a current preview; Kalshi has the over near 54%.

NBA|3136195|pra.note: Under Mike Brown, Towns is reported to be in more of a passing role and a preview takes his points under, but a fact-check could not confirm the role change or low preseason scoring.

detail.availability: No injury listed. Towns played all of the preseason, including the finale.
detail.role: Brown said in camp that Towns would work more from the elbow as a facilitator. He totaled 37 points in 74 minutes over the first four preseason games, then had a 13-point, 15-assist, 9-rebound finale, so his scoring share has fallen even as his assists rose.
detail.matchup: Philadelphia has Embiid healthy at center, which makes a physical interior assignment. With Hukporti out and Bona/Fall banged up, the 76ers do have thin center depth behind Embiid.
detail.script: Knicks are favored by about 5 with a total around 232. Previews lean under, and a comfortable lead could trim starter minutes.
detail.market: There was no Kalshi price. Sportsmole had Towns' points line at 18.5 and recommended the under.
detail.experts: Sportsmole picks the under on Towns' points because Brunson and Anunoby carried the preseason scoring, and it names Embiid as a tough matchup. A Knicks film breakdown calls Towns more valuable as a passer than a scorer in this offense.

NBA|3934719|pts.note: Brown's offense gives Anunoby more pick-and-roll work as the clear second option. The market's points number appears to sit near 18.5-19, above the 16.5 in the packet.

detail.role: Brown said in camp that Anunoby and Bridges would get more pick-and-roll chances and that Anunoby would play some small-ball center. A film breakdown calls him the No. 2 option, drawing switches off Brunson screens.
detail.matchup: Philadelphia is still fitting its new pieces together on defense. Its frontcourt depth is thin with Hukporti out and Barlow and Wade hurt.
detail.script: Knicks are home favorites by 4.5-6 in a game totaled near 232, so his normal starter minutes should hold.
detail.market: Fanatics lists Anunoby 19+ points at +100, which puts the market median near 18.5-19. The current main line is probably higher than 16.5, so check it; the edge shrinks if the line is 18.5.
detail.experts: Sportsmole says Brunson and Anunoby carried New York's preseason scoring.

NBA|3917376|pr.note: Brown is healthy and played well in the preseason, but he shares the ball with Embiid, James and Maxey, and the market's points number lines up with this combo line.

detail.availability: No injury. The game he missed in the preseason was not explained, and he played the finale.
detail.role: In the preseason finale he had 20 points and 8 rebounds on 8-of-14 shooting, and he scored 22 against these Knicks in the preseason opener. Nurse praised his work as a driver.
detail.matchup: He will likely draw Anunoby or Bridges, both strong wing defenders.
detail.script: As road underdogs by about 5 with a 232 total, the 76ers should play a normal-paced game. Starter minutes should be full unless the game gets out of hand.
detail.market: Fanatics lists Brown 21+ points at +100, a median near 20.5 points, which with about 6 rebounds fits a 26.5 line.
detail.experts: Sportsmole expects fewer touches for Maxey because Brown, James and Embiid all need the ball. The same crowding applies to Brown.

NBA|3136195|pts.note: Under Mike Brown, Towns is reported to be in more of a passing role and a preview takes his points under, but a fact-check could not confirm the role change or low preseason scoring.

detail.role: Over the first four preseason games he scored 37 points in 74 minutes, and his finale was assist-heavy with 13 points.
detail.experts: Sportsmole recommends under 18.5 points because Brunson and Anunoby carry the scoring and Embiid is a tough matchup.

NBA|3136195|ast.note: The app leans under, but Towns' new high-post role produced 15 assists in the finale and a team-high 18 in the four earlier games. His role cuts against an assists under.

detail.role: Brown said in camp that Towns would facilitate from the elbow. He led the team in preseason assists and had 15 in the finale.

NBA|3062679|reb.note: Hart's right ankle kept him out of the preseason finale. Brown expects him to play, but Hart would not commit on Sunday, so his minutes are less certain than usual.

detail.availability: Hart missed the preseason finale with right ankle soreness. Per SNY's Ian Begley, Brown does not expect it to affect his availability, while Hart said on Sunday that they would see. Sportsmole lists him as probable.
detail.role: If he sits, McBride and Shamet are the likely fill-ins. Diawara started the finale for a defensive matchup.

NFL|00-0039910|car.note: With lead back Croskey-Merritt ruled out and only White/Ekeler (both limited this week) behind him, Daniels figures to handle more designed and scramble runs, as he did with 9 carries in his return.

detail.availability: Daniels was a full practice participant all week after returning from a dislocated left elbow in Week 5; no designation.
detail.role: In his return against the Giants he ran 9 times for 103 yards and two long touchdowns while throwing only 25 passes.
detail.script: Previews expect Washington to trail as a 7.5-point dog, which adds scrambles even if it trims designed runs late.
detail.market: Kalshi sits around 54.5% on the over, above the 52.4% break-even; preview parlays target his rushing yardage over 40.
detail.experts: TheLines and Covers both cite the Croskey-Merritt absence as the reason they expect Daniels to run often and score on the ground.

NFL|00-0039910|cmp.note: Daniels has not reached 200 passing yards in his two full games and completed 17 of 25 in his return; Washington's offense is leaning on his legs with the top back out.

detail.availability: Full practice all week after missing two games with a dislocated left (non-throwing) elbow; he played a full game last week.
detail.role: Last week he went 17-of-25 for 199 yards, and TheLines notes he has been under 200 passing yards in both full games this season.
detail.matchup: San Francisco is without Nick Bosa, which eases pressure, but previews still rank the 49ers top-10 in pass defense and third in points allowed.
detail.script: Trailing by a touchdown or more could lift pass volume late, the main risk to the under.
detail.market: Kalshi has the over near 46%, leaning under.
detail.experts: TheLines takes his passing yards over on a catch-up script, but none of the previews read cited a completion-volume case.

NFL|00-0037809|rec.note: Okonkwo led Washington's pass-catchers in snaps last week (71%) and caught 4 for 60, with Diggs still questionable on a hamstring and McLaurin managed through his own hamstring.

detail.availability: No injury designation.
detail.role: Played 44 of 64 snaps (71%) against the Giants, more than McLaurin (58%), with a 4-catch, 60-yard line.
detail.script: A trailing script as a 7.5-point dog should raise Washington's dropbacks.
detail.market: Kalshi around 56% on the over, above break-even.
detail.experts: Previews focus on Antonio Williams and McLaurin; nothing specific on Okonkwo.

NFL|00-0035659|recyd.note: McLaurin is playing through a hamstring issue dating to Week 4, sat Friday practice and played only 58% of snaps last week, which offsets the extra target share Diggs' uncertainty could create.

detail.availability: Not on the final injury report, but did not practice Friday (described as rest for a hamstring he has managed since Week 4).
detail.role: Played 36 of 64 snaps (58%) in Week 5 with 4 catches for 62 yards; Covers says he did not handle a full workload.
detail.script: Trailing script supports volume if he plays a normal snap share.
detail.market: Kalshi near 50.7%, a coin flip; DraftKings preview has 50+ yards at about -103.
detail.experts: TheLines backs 50+ yards, citing three straight games over 50 and Diggs' questionable tag.

NFL|00-0033288|recyd.note: With Samuel out and Evans (ribs, calf) and Kirk questionable, Kittle is the clear top target against a Washington defense weak against tight ends; most books list him at 63.5.

detail.availability: No designation; fullback Juszczyk returns, which helps the run game without cutting Kittle's routes.
detail.role: Over 70 yards in each of the first four weeks before 24 against Seattle.
detail.matchup: Washington has allowed seven TE touchdowns and roughly 82 receiving yards per game to tight ends.
detail.market: Current preview lines are 63.5 (some 64.5-65.5), below the app's 67.5; Kalshi 60+ is priced near 58%.
detail.experts: Bettors Insider, SportsBettingDime and TheLines all lean to Kittle's yardage over for the same target-share reason.

NFL|00-0031408|recyd.note: Evans has rib and calf injuries, did not practice at all this week and is questionable; even if active, his workload is at risk.

detail.availability: Questionable (ribs, calf); Shanahan said the decision comes Monday; he only did side conditioning Saturday.
detail.role: Christian Kirk may be activated, and Kittle projects as the primary target.
detail.market: Kalshi near 50%; if he is ruled out the prop voids, so the risk is a limited-snap appearance.
detail.experts: Previews treat Kittle, not Evans, as Purdy's most trusted healthy option this week.

NFL|00-0037834|ryd.note: Washington's defense has allowed season-high rushing totals to opposing quarterbacks, and Purdy has run for 29+ yards in four of five games this year.

detail.role: Purdy has 29+ rushing yards in four of five games; with two top receivers hurt, scramble chances rise.
detail.matchup: Washington allows about 19.4 QB rushing yards per game (7th most); Winston, Prescott and Hurts each beat their rushing lines against them.
detail.market: Kalshi about 49.7% at 18.5, below where the preview projects him.
detail.experts: Covers' top play is Purdy 20+ rushing yards, projecting about 29 yards.

NFL|00-0033280|td.note: McCaffrey has all five 49ers rushing touchdowns in five games, plays about 80% of snaps, and the 49ers convert 87.5% of red-zone trips against the league's worst scoring defense.

detail.role: Five rushing TDs in five games and roughly 80% snap share; fullback Juszczyk returns to lead block.
detail.matchup: Washington allows 29.8 points per game, worst in the league.
detail.script: 7.5-point home favorite with an implied total near 30 points.
detail.market: Kalshi about 69.5%, near the app's 66%; sportsbooks around -280.
detail.experts: Universal anytime-TD favorite in previews; buzz is high but the case rests on his goal-line role.

NFL|00-0033288|td.note: Kittle is tied for the team lead with six red-zone targets, and with Samuel out and Evans doubtful to be at full strength, more of those looks should come his way against a defense that has allowed seven TE scores.

detail.role: Tied with Evans for the team lead in red-zone targets (6) with four TDs this season.
detail.matchup: Washington has allowed seven touchdowns to tight ends, second most in the league.
detail.market: Kalshi about 45.5%; books around +105 to +110.
detail.experts: Yahoo/Action Network and bet365 both pick Kittle to score, advising against paying worse than even money.

NFL|00-0031408|td.note: Evans missed every practice this week with rib and calf injuries; Kalshi near 52% looks rich for a questionable receiver whose red-zone looks may shift to Kittle.

detail.availability: Questionable, no practice all week; Shanahan expects a Monday decision.
detail.market: Kalshi 52.5% vs app 40%; bet365 lists him around -130.
detail.experts: Previews pivot red-zone expectations to Kittle with Evans limited.

SOC|173896|401888277.note: Healthy, captained the side and had a goal plus an assist at KuPS on Oct 15; Trabzonspor were managing his load for the Besiktas match. Onuachu reportedly picked up a knock in that match.

SOC|198825|401900896.note: Fit and scoring: he scored for Al Hilal in the Asian Champions League on Oct 14. No injury reported, and no predicted lineup found for Al Hazem.

SOC|316609|401874784.note: TMW's Oct 18 preview has him starting in Parma's midfield three beside Bernabe and Fabbian. He is not on the injury list (Elphege, Almqvist and Nicolussi are out).

SOC|210392|401874784.note: Predicted to start in Torino's two-man midfield with Braganca, in a 4-man back line under Abate. No injury or suspension reported.

SOC|191337|401879257.note: In the Oct 16 preview's predicted Coventry XI as a central midfielder. Coventry's absentees are Amenda, Woolfenden, Eccles and Wright, so he is not among them.

SOC|241093|401879257.note: Predicted to start at centre-back for Coventry, with Woolfenden out injured. No suspension or injury reported for him.

SOC|310709|401915404.note: No current injury or lineup news found ahead of Tuesday's Champions League match.

SOC|186381|401915404.note: No current injury news found. His only reported problem was a precautionary training stop in July. He remains Dortmund's main striker.

SOC|22774|401900446.note: No current injury, suspension or rotation news found for the NEOM match.

SOC|320459|401880277.note: No current injury news found. The only ankle problem in the results dates from October 2025.

SOC|239738|401915401.note: No current injury or lineup news found ahead of AEK's trip to Manchester City.

SOC|331047|401915397.note: No current injury or lineup news found ahead of Villarreal at Liverpool.

SOC|259481|401915402.note: No current injury news found. He has been a regular for Roma this season; Benfica preview not yet available.

SOC|235662|401915397.note: No current team news found for Villarreal. He starts only about 62% of matches, so his place is uncertain until Slot's press conference.

NBA|4066261|pra.note: Adebayo returned to practice Sunday from a groin issue and is aiming to play the opener; no posted line found to confirm the 29.5.

NBA|5104157|3pm.note: No injury news for Wembanyama, who played in the preseason finale; nothing found that moves his three-point volume either way, and no current line confirmed.

NBA|5104157|ra.note: Wembanyama is healthy, and the Spurs' new three-guard starting lineup leaves him as the main big on the glass, which argues against the under; no current line confirmed.

NFL|00-0034173|kpts.note: Pineiro is not on the 49ers' injury report and should kick; nothing found beyond the numbers, and no posted line confirmed.

NFL|00-0037256|ryd.note: White was limited late in the week with a shoulder issue and is expected to split the work with Ekeler while Daniels takes more runs; he has averaged under 30 rushing yards a game.

NBA|1966|pa.note: No injury has been reported for James ahead of his first regular-season game with Philadelphia; he sat part of the preseason with no injury given, so nothing found beyond the numbers.

NFL|00-0036275|car.note: Kyle Monangai, who took 30 carries in Week 4, is out, and the team expects Swift to be the clear lead back with Roschon Johnson mostly on passing downs.

detail.availability: Not on this week's injury report after being limited by hip and knee concerns in the second half of the Packers game.
detail.role: Monangai's carries open up; Swift had only nine carries last week in a 31-7 loss, a script-driven low.
detail.script: Chicago is a slight road favorite, a better script than last week's blowout.

NFL|00-0039918|ryd.note: Williams returns from a hamstring injury that cost him three games and needed a final test to be cleared, so designed runs and scrambles may be dialed back.

detail.availability: Full practices all week but still questionable; Schefter reports he is expected to start.
detail.role: Hamstring injuries tend to limit running; no team comment on restricting his runs was found.

NFL|00-0033090|rec.note: A.J. Brown's possible return from IR could take targets from Henry, but Brown's conditioning is unproven and his snaps may be limited. A.J. Brown is now expected to be active and play a good share of snaps.

detail.availability: Henry is healthy.
detail.role: Brown was activated Saturday after limited practices Wednesday and Thursday; Vrabel said his conditioning still had to be checked.
detail.matchup: Jets defense has held three of five opponents under 200 total yards.

NFL|00-0039919|rec.note: Odunze is off the injury report and starting at WR1, but he has topped 3.5 catches only once in his last ten games, and Chicago's offense runs heavily through D'Andre Swift.

detail.availability: No injury designation.
detail.role: Averaging 2.8 catches over his last ten; Burden and Loveland share targets.

NFL|00-0035659|rec.note: McLaurin is playing through a hamstring issue, sat Friday practice and played only 58% of snaps last week; Diggs remains a game-time decision, so a bigger target share is possible but his snap count is the risk.

NFL|00-0033280|recyd.note: McCaffrey is healthy and the lead back; with Samuel out and Evans questionable, short targets could flow his way, but Kittle is the clear top option, so nothing found beyond the numbers.

NBA|4065648|pa.note: Tatum is expected to play in the opener at Detroit after resting the last preseason game, with no minutes limit reported; in 16 games back from his Achilles injury last season he averaged about 27 points plus assists in under 33 minutes.

CFB-week.summary: Checked Covers, BettingPros, Action Network and general searches on Monday morning for the three Tuesday games (MTSU at FIU, Missouri State at Delaware, South Alabama at Marshall). No player prop lines from a named book were posted yet, so no lines were screened and no picks were made.

NBA-ATL-at-ORL-1021.summary: Orlando opens at home as a 2.5-point favorite over Atlanta, with the total at 234.5. Franz Wagner (right shoulder) is questionable after only light work Sunday, Penda (partial hamstring tear) is out, and Black and Richardson are day-to-day. Atlanta is healthy apart from Veesaar (ACL), with McCollum locked in as the starting point guard.

NBA-BOS-at-DET-1020.summary: Opening-day matinee in Detroit with a near pick'em spread (around 1.5 either way) and a total of about 222. Boston no longer has Jaylen Brown, so Tatum is the clear first option, but Detroit was a top-two defense last season. Both teams report no meaningful injuries; Boston's only absence is two-way guard Devin Carter (mono).

NBA-CHI-at-TOR-1021.summary: Toronto is a 9.5-point home favorite (opened 8.5) with the total up to 236.5, so the pace is fast but there is blowout risk. The Raptors traded Ingram for Kawhi Leonard, who is expected to play after resting the preseason finale, which takes touches from Barrett and Barnes. Chicago is without starting center Nic Claxton (hamstring) and plans to run.

NBA-MIN-at-MIA-1021.summary: Season opener and debut game for Giannis in Miami and LaMelo Ball in Minnesota. Adebayo (groin) and Larsson (illness) practiced Sunday and expect to play; Dru Smith (calf) is less certain, and Spoelstra has talked about Adebayo and Giannis initiating offense while Smith is out. Minnesota is without DiVincenzo, and McDaniels' expanded scoring role next to Ball was the clearest preseason trend.

NBA-OKC-at-SA-1021.summary: Finals-rematch opener in San Antonio with the Spurs about 2.5-point favorites and a total near 229.5. The Spurs confirmed a three-guard starting five of Fox, Castle, Harper, Vassell and Wembanyama while Tobias Harris (calf) sits, which spreads ball-handling across three guards. OKC's Chet Holmgren (quad) missed all of preseason and is uncertain; Dort, Wiggins and Joe are gone.

NBA-PHI-at-NY-1020.summary: The champion Knicks host a reshaped 76ers (Jaylen Brown via trade, LeBron James signed) on opening night. Books have New York favored by 4.5-6 with a total near 231.5-232, and previews lean Knicks and the under. Josh Hart (right ankle) is the only Knicks worry, and Mike Brown expects him to play. Philadelphia's main stars are healthy, but Hukporti is out for the season and several reserves are banged up.

NFL-WAS-at-SF-1020.summary: Washington is without RB1 Croskey-Merritt (groin), so White and Ekeler split the backfield and previews expect Daniels, back from a two-game elbow absence with 9 carries for 103 yards last week, to carry more of the run game. San Francisco is missing Bosa, Samuel, safety Sigle and LB Wallow; Mike Evans (ribs, calf) did not practice all week and is a game-time call, pushing targets toward Kittle against a Washington defense that is among the worst versus tight ends. SOCCER-day.summary: Monday's previews have Keita, Mandragora, Grimes and Pinnock in their predicted XIs, and Salah and Watkins are fit and scored or assisted in European games last week. Tuesday's Champions League, Saudi and Championship players had no fresh team news yet, so they are neutral.

NFL-DAL-at-GB-1019.summary: Sunday Night Football at Lambeau (kickoff 8:20 PM ET Sunday Oct 18; the packet id's date is UTC). Green Bay's defensive front is badly thinned: Parsons, Hargrave (season over) and Ford are out, Riley is doubtful and Campbell questionable. Its receiver room lost Jayden Reed for the season and Skyy Moore for this game. Dallas is without CB Cobie Durant, LB Overshown and RT Drew Shelton; Javonte Williams is getting nearly every running-back opportunity but averaging under 4 yards per carry.

best.why: Lead back Jacory Croskey-Merritt is ruled out after missing every practice, leaving a White-Ekeler split with both limited this week. Daniels practiced fully and ran 9 times in his return last week, so 7+ carries needs only his normal designed-run and scramble load.
